name: Ammo Drum
effect: You can carry one additional Ammo.

mods.what: the wielder can carry one additional Ammo

name: Autoloader
effect: You can Reload your weapon as a Free Action.

mods.what: Reload this weapon as a Free Action

name: Bayonet Lug
effect: You can use this weapon as a Knife (p.210). Mounts a blade on a firearm.

fits.condition: a firearm a blade can be mounted on

mods.what: this weapon can also be used as a Knife (Core p.210)

name: Chain Bayonet
effect: You can use this weapon as a Chain Bayonet (p.211). Mechanically attached to a firearm.

fits.condition: a firearm a bayonet can be mechanically attached to

mods.what: this weapon can also be used as a Chain Bayonet (Core p.211)

note: id suffixed -upgrade to avoid clashing with the Chain Bayonet melee weapon (p.211).

name: Combi Weapon
effect: A combi-weapon may be fired as either or both of its component weapons each round. Firing both component weapons is treated as a Multi-Attack. You must own the two ranged weapons you want to combine when you purchase this upgrade. Pistols can only be combined with other Pistols, and weapons with the Heavy Trait cannot take this upgrade.

fits.condition: a Pistol only combines with another Pistol

mods.what: fire either component weapon each round, or both as a Multi-Attack
you must already own both ranged weapons when you buy this upgrade

name: Distinction
effect: +1 bonus die to Intimidation (Wil) Tests when you brandish this weapon. Distinction does not count toward a weapon's maximum number of upgrades.

mods.when: Intimidation (Wil) Tests while brandishing this weapon

name: Duelling Grip
effect: +1 bonus die on Attack Tests using this weapon. This upgrade can only be applied to Pistols or one-handed melee weapons.

fits.condition: a Pistol or a one-handed melee weapon

name: Gene-Grip Bio-Verator
effect: Any mechanisms your weapon has (triggers, chain engines, etc.) will not activate for anyone but you.

fits.condition: a weapon with mechanisms: a trigger, a chain engine or the like

mods.what: the weapon's mechanisms will not activate for anyone but its owner

name: Mastercrafted
effect: The weapon gains the Reliable Trait. You gain +2 bonus dice to any Attack Test made with this weapon.

mods.when: any Attack Test made with this weapon

name: Megathoule Accelerator (Lucius Pattern)
effect: The weapon gains +2 Damage. The weapon loses the Reliable Trait. This upgrade can only be applied to a Las weapon.

name: Magnocular Scope
effect: Awareness (Int) Tests made with a Magnocular Scope suffer no penalties due to distance. When a Magnocular Scope is attached to a weapon, all Range penalties are reduced by –2. Attaches to most firearms.

mods.what: Range penalties with this weapon are reduced by 2
Awareness (Int) Tests made through the scope suffer no penalties for distance

name: Percussive Muzzle Brake
effect: The weapon gains +1 Salvo. This upgrade can only be applied to a weapon that does not have the Heavy Trait.

name: Preysense Sight
effect: This weapon upgrade allows the wielder to detect targets via ambient heat, even in total darkness.

mods.what: the wielder detects targets by ambient heat, even in total darkness

name: Red-Dot Sight
effect: +1 bonus die to ranged attacks made with this weapon.

mods.when: ranged attacks made with this weapon

name: Silencer
effect: The weapon gains the Silent Trait. This upgrade can only be applied to a weapon with the BOLT or PROJECTILE Keywords.

name: Dragonfire Bolt Rounds
effect: Only for weapons with the BOLT Keyword. The weapon gains the Spread Trait. The weapon ignores Defence bonuses from cover.

name: Hellfire Bolt Rounds
effect: Only for weapons with the BOLT Keyword. +3 ED against organic targets. +2 ED against inorganic targets.

name: Kraken Bolt Rounds
effect: Only for weapons with the BOLT Keyword. AP -2

name: Ammo Backpack
effect: You can carry 10 additional Ammo. Comes stocked with 3 available Ammo.

name: Bandolier
effect: You can carry 2 additional Ammo. Comes stocked with 3 available Ammo.
